sources.title: Bonzah Facio Demo Specification v1.0
sources.sourceBoundary: Hash identifies the captured readable source snapshot, not the original Office binary. Source claims do not establish implementation, carrier approval, production readiness or customer acceptance.

sources.title: API Documentation Requirments
sources.sourceBoundary: Readable product and coverage description only. It does not supply an approved endpoint, authentication, error or webhook contract.

sources.title: Bonzah Insurance Initial Claim Form
sources.sourceBoundary: Form fields and workflow are requirements evidence. Jotform operation, live data processing and external delivery are not authorized or verified.

requirements.title: DTC and partner parity
requirements.expectedOutcome: Equivalent canonical risk and coverage inputs return the same release, decision, coverage prices, fee components and customer total.
dependencies: Bonzah tenant ID, deployed access and supported-journey list are required before a permanent UI adapter is connected.
requirements.sourceBoundary: The frozen Abbeygate demo is reference evidence, not the production architecture or proof of Kernel support.

requirements.title: Allowed rental vehicle
requirements.expectedOutcome: The synthetic 2025 Toyota RAV4 scenario quotes and binds when all other rules and verified-money gates pass.
dependencies: Carrier-approved appetite and rate values remain customer inputs.
requirements.sourceBoundary: The vehicle and expected outcome are synthetic; current sandbox rates are unapproved.

requirements.title: Vehicle exclusion and referral
requirements.expectedOutcome: A configured prohibited make/model declines and an ambiguous or high-value trim refers with a stable reason and evidence request.
dependencies: Approved prohibited and referral lists are required.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Current Porsche and high-value examples are demonstration assumptions.

requirements.title: SLI requires RCLI
requirements.expectedOutcome: SLI cannot be selected, quoted or bound without RCLI across UI and API.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Dependency is implemented in the development definition; wording and limits remain unapproved.

requirements.title: Pricing and bind integrity
requirements.expectedOutcome: Stale or modified client prices cannot bind; the server re-evaluates the exact retained release and canonical inputs.
dependencies: Dynamic fee and tax must join the signed evaluation before this is complete.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Kernel has retained release/evaluation contracts; complete Bonzah bind proof is pending.

requirements.title: Verified payment or receivable gate
requirements.expectedOutcome: Pending or failed money state blocks issue, verified state permits issue, and retries are idempotent.
dependencies: Approved hosted payment and partner receivable contracts are missing reusable capabilities.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Simulated Abbeygate payment is evidence only and is forbidden in production execution.

requirements.title: Coverage certificates
requirements.expectedOutcome: Each selected coverage produces an approved certificate matching the bound risk, drivers, limits, dates and transaction version.
dependencies: Bonzah or carrier-approved templates, wording rights and numbering rules are required.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Synthetic document capability does not constitute an approved certificate.

requirements.title: Rental extension transaction
requirements.expectedOutcome: A two-day pre-expiry extension creates a new transaction, exact delta and replacement documents without changing the original quote, policy or documents.
dependencies: Approved extension money, fee, tax and document behavior is required.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Kernel configured service supports retained extensions; Bonzah acceptance remains pending.

requirements.title: Immutable history
requirements.expectedOutcome: Original bound transaction, quote, release and document versions remain retrievable and byte/hash unchanged after service.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Kernel has reusable immutable history; Bonzah-specific executed proof remains pending.

requirements.title: Scoped public FNOL
requirements.expectedOutcome: A short-lived public link prefills authorized policy/rental data and supports required evidence, preparer, save/resume and external handoff.

sourceRefs.locator: Full captured form and blueprint Section 10

dependencies: Public tokenized FNOL access and approved carrier/TPA handoff are missing reusable capabilities.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Internal FNOL is synthetic and does not prove public or external operation.

requirements.title: Aggregate migration reconciliation
requirements.expectedOutcome: A controlled dry-run reconciles 2,571 purchases and 460 endorsements across both supplied schemas while exposing no row-level PII.
dependencies: Approved source files, mappings and run authorization are required.
requirements.sourceBoundary: No production workbook rows were inspected or imported for this intake.

requirements.title: Correlated audit chain
requirements.expectedOutcome: Correlation, actor, release, rule, template and transaction timestamps connect quote through bind and extension.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Reusable audit capability exists; Bonzah end-to-end evidence is pending.

requirements.title: Synthetic privacy boundary
requirements.expectedOutcome: No real customer names, contacts, addresses, policy numbers, payment IDs or secrets appear in UI, logs, evidence exports or backups.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Only synthetic fixtures may be used until explicit controlled-data authorization.

requirements.title: Reset and fallback
requirements.expectedOutcome: The isolated environment resets in under five minutes and static/API/report fallbacks preserve the same synthetic identifiers.
dependencies: Approved reset scope and evidence-retention boundary are required.
requirements.sourceBoundary: A local reset is not a deployed rehearsal or customer acceptance result.

requirements.title: Effective-dated insurance fee
requirements.expectedOutcome: Versioned configuration supports fixed, percentage or per-day insurance fees, effective dates, minimum and maximum amounts, and separate exact-money output components.

sourceRefs.locator: Money and pricing sections; current handoff direction

dependencies: Exact sandbox percentage/minimum/maximum values require Bonzah approval.
Kernel currently has no reusable fee/tax component contract.
requirements.sourceBoundary: No fee value is production-approved; zero commission in the intake policy is a blocker marker, not a customer rate.

requirements.title: Environmental and vehicle factor provenance
requirements.expectedOutcome: Every state, vehicle and environmental factor is versioned with source metadata, effective dates, explicit fallback behavior and customer approval state.

sourceRefs.locator: Risk/rating requirements plus frozen Abbeygate reference

dependencies: Bonzah must approve derivation and intended use of FARS/FHWA, NOAA and theft factors.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Current multipliers are unapproved demonstration evidence and must not be described as actuarial or production rates.

requirements.title: Partner compatibility facade
requirements.expectedOutcome: An authenticated compatibility adapter maps approved Bonzah/Insillion request, response, error and webhook contracts to canonical Kernel operations without trusting partner identity in payloads.

sourceRefs.locator: Repository link and blueprint compatibility operations

dependencies: Current Insillion schemas, authentication and supported journeys must be supplied and approved.
requirements.sourceBoundary: The Abbeygate partner API is a fixture/reference implementation only.

requirements.title: Public DTC adapter
requirements.expectedOutcome: The branded public site uses a typed Kernel adapter for quote, decision, retention, bind and servicing while Studio remains authenticated and operational.
dependencies: Tenant ID, deployed access and supported-journey list are required.
requirements.sourceBoundary: The recreated UI may continue visually; it must not make Abbeygate the permanent backend.

requirements.title: Approved certificate templates
requirements.expectedOutcome: Approved versioned certificate templates and delivery contracts cover CDW, RCLI, SLI and PAI/PEI.
dependencies: Template files, rights, wording owner, numbering and sign-off are required.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Sample policies in Drive were not treated as approved reusable templates.

requirements.title: Hosted payment integration
requirements.expectedOutcome: Provider-hosted card collection returns a verified token/receipt; Kernel never receives card data and issue fails closed on pending, failed or ambiguous outcomes.
dependencies: Provider, credentials, webhook/authentication and reconciliation contract are unapproved.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Simulated payment is non-production evidence only.

requirements.title: Partner receivable
requirements.expectedOutcome: Partner-collected consideration creates separate premium, fee, tax, commission/remuneration and receivable components with exposure and reconciliation states.
dependencies: Approved accounting basis, custody, payer, cadence, tax and settlement rules are required.
requirements.sourceBoundary: A calculated commission or synthetic journal does not prove a receivable or settlement.

requirements.title: External carrier and TPA delivery
requirements.expectedOutcome: Policy, endorsement, document and FNOL handoffs are authenticated, idempotent, observable and reconciled to approved carrier/TPA contracts.
dependencies: Destinations, payloads, credentials, ownership and recovery behavior are required.
requirements.sourceBoundary: Pending outbox intent or a synthetic destination does not prove external delivery.
